purpose: Conformance fixtures that fail because the simulator differs from the written specification. These are expected to fail until a supervised fix lands. They are separate from the certification gate in tests/edison/run.py, which neither reads this file nor runs these fixtures. When a fix lands, the case reports RECORDED FAILURE NOW PASSES and its entry must be removed.
